data.name: Aarifin
data.gender_notes: Aarifin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who knows or is well-versed in a particular subject. The name Aarifin carries the meaning “Knower, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Malay. Parents who choose Aarifin usually hope their child will grow to embody knower, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Aarifin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knower, Scholar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aarifin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عریفین
in_arabic.meaning: معنیہ یہ کہ ایماندار، دانا، ادراک والا، پائیدار
in_arabic.long_meaning: عریفین کا معنیہ یہ ہے کہ ایک ایماندار اور دانا شخص جو اپنے ادراک کے مطابق کام کرتا ہے، اللہ تعالیٰ کے احکامات کی پابندی کے ساتھ، دین کی تعلیمات کو پورا کرنے کے لئے، اور اپنی زندگی کو ایک پائیدار اور شاندار زندگی بنانے کی کوشش کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید کی سورہ یوسف کی آیت 77 میں مذکور ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ نے یوسف علیہ السلام کو عریف بنایا تھا۔

in_urdu.name: عریفین
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام ایماندار، دانا، ادراک والا، پائیدار کے معنی میں لیا جاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عریفین نام کا تعلق ایک ایماندار اور دانا شخص سے ہے جو اپنے ادراک کے مطابق کام کرتا ہے، اللہ تعالیٰ کے احکامات کی پابندی کے ساتھ، دین کی تعلیمات کو پورا کرنے کے لئے، اور اپنی زندگی کو ایک پائیدار اور شاندار زندگی بنانے کی کوشش کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایات میں بھی مشہور ہے، اور اس کے معنیہ کے مطابق ایماندارانہ اور دانا شخص بننے کی کوشش کی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अरीफीन
in_hindi.meaning: ये नाम ईमानदार, ज्ञानी, समझदार, और स्थिर होने के अर्थ में लिया जाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरीफीन नाम एक ईमानदार और ज्ञानी व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो अपने ज्ञान के अनुसार काम करता है, अल्लाह के आदेशों का पालन करता है, और अपनी जिंदगी को एक स्थिर और खूबसूरत जिंदगी बनाने के लिए कोशिश करता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रसिद्ध है, और इसके अर्थ के अनुसार एक ईमानदार और ज्ञानी व्यक्ति बनने की कोशिश की जाती है।

in_english.name: Aarifin
in_english.meaning: Aarifin is a name that means intelligent, wise, understanding, and trustworthy
in_english.long_meaning: Aarifin is a name that signifies an intelligent and wise person who acts according to their understanding, follows Allah's commandments, and strives to live a beautiful and enduring life according to Islamic teachings. This name has its roots in the Arabic language and is mentioned in the Quran. The root of the word 'Aarifin' is 'A-R-F', which means 'to know' or 'to understand'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aarifin in Islamic culture signifies knowledge, wisdom, and education. It is a name of honor and respect, often given to individuals who are known for their deep understanding and expertise in various subjects such as Islamic studies, Quranic sciences, or other academic fields. The cultural significance of this name emphasizes the importance of learning and seeking knowledge, as it is a fundamental aspect of personal growth and development in the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Aarifin holds great significance as it is derived from the Arabic word "arif," which means "to know Allah." Thus, the name can be understood as a reminder of the ultimate goal of human existence, which is to gain knowledge and closeness to Allah. Furthermore, it is believed that those who are labeled as "arif," or "knowers of Allah," possess a deep inner understanding and sense of piety towards their Creator. This spiritual significance highlights the importance of seeking knowledge not just for the sake of worldly gains, but for the ultimate purpose of drawing closer to Allah and fulfilling one's spiritual potential.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Knower, Scholar" symbolizes Someone who knows or is well-versed in a particular subject.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aarifin serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of knower, scholar.
